description: A three-quarter arc tracking progress toward a goal, with the count shown in the center.
overview: A three-quarter arc tracking progress toward a goal, with the count shown in the center. Use it for goals with a clear finish line, like a reading challenge or a savings target.
usage: Set the progress as a percentage in `chartData`, or change the `domain` on `PolarAngleAxis` to your goal and pass the raw count. Update the center text and caption, and set the color in `chartConfig`.
notes: The center text is hard-coded and not derived from the value, so update both together. There is no tooltip.
